is_anopheles.evidence: The study was conducted on wild Anopheles gambiae (s.l.) mosquitoes and laboratory An. gambiae Kisumu strain (page 2, 'Methods').

reports_target_markers.evidence: Detection of Leu-Phe kdr mutation (Vgsc L995F) and insensitive acetylcholinesterase mutation Ace-1 (Ace-1 G280S) is reported (page 4, 'Detection of Leu-Phe kdr mutation...' and page 5, Table 2).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 2 (page 5) reports exact genotype counts for N=30 wild mosquitoes from Cov p: kdr (RR=27, RS=3, SS=0, frequency=0.95) and Ace-1 (RR=0, RS=2, SS=28, frequency=0.03).

african_field_population.evidence: Wild Anopheles gambiae (s.l.) mosquitoes collected at the experimental station in Cov p, Southern Benin (page 2 and Table 2).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary research article reporting an experimental hut trial and associated baseline bioassays/genotyping.

sub_country_location.evidence: Collections and testing were carried out at Cov p, Zou department, Southern Benin (page 2, 'Study design').

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The trial and collections were carried out between October 2015 and May 2016 (page 2, 'Study design').

duplicate_risk.evidence: Standard experimental hut trial conducted by CREC in Benin using locally collected mosquitoes from Cov p.

supplement.evidence: All required genotype counts and frequencies are reported directly in Table 2 of the main text.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated the efficacy of SumiShield 50WG IRS against pyrethroid-resistant Anopheles gambiae (s.l.) in experimental huts in Cov p, Benin. As part of characterising the wild population, 30 untested mosquitoes were genotyped for Vgsc L995F (kdr-w) and Ace-1 G280S, with complete RR/RS/SS counts provided in Table 2.
